user.title: Set up shift plan
user.description:
One entry per person. Shifts, one per line, as `Code;Name;Start;End;Type;Color;Hours`. If `End` is earlier than `Start` the shift ends the next day (night shift). Without times an all-day event is created. Type: empty = shift, `urlaub` (vacation), `abwesend` (absent, e.g. sick) or `frei` (no event). `Hours` = paid hours (e.g. 6.5), otherwise the duration from start to end. Please double-check all times against the posted roster.

{error}

data_description.vacation_days: For the remaining vacation. Vacation days from Monday to Friday are counted.

init.title: Edit shift plan
init.description:
Shifts, one per line, as `Code;Name;Start;End;Type;Color;Hours`. Changed times or names are updated in the target calendar automatically.

{error}

data.sync_calendar: Also add events to this calendar (optional)

error.invalid_shifts: The shift definition contains an error (see hint above).
error.no_shifts: Please define at least one shift.
error.sync_self: Please choose a different calendar, not the shift plan itself.

unknown_shift.message: Unknown shift "{shift}". It is not defined in the shifts.

invalid_range.message: Invalid range: the end date must not be before the start date (max. 366 days).

set_shift.name: Set shift
set_shift.description: Enters a shift for a day or a range of days. Without a shift the entry is removed.

date.name: Date
date.description: Day (or first day of the range).

shift.name: Shift
shift.description: Shift code, e.g. F1. Leave empty to remove.

set_shifts.name: Set multiple shifts
set_shifts.description: Enters shifts for several days at once (date → code, empty = remove).

days.name: Days
days.description: Mapping of date to shift code.

sync.name: Sync
sync.description: Copies all days that have not been transferred yet or have changed to the target calendar.

regenerate_link.name: Renew calendar link
regenerate_link.description: Creates a new subscription link (iCal). The previous link stops working.

ask.name: Ask for a shift
ask.description: Answers “How is Jenny working tomorrow?” as a ready-made German sentence (to be spoken by Alexa, Assist or scripts). Returns a response with “speech”, “date” and “people”.

person.name: Person
person.description: Name of the person (empty = everyone). With a single shift plan that plan is always meant.

day.name: Day
day.description: heute, morgen, übermorgen, gestern, a weekday, a date (2026-10-05 or 5.10.) or “nächster” for the next shift.
